entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: The small, cinnamon-brown rabbitfolk mayor of Goodhill, charismatic and flamboyant.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: The town on Bloomburrow of which Oliver is mayor.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Holder of the family heirloom Cragflame, who takes charge when a stranger arrives in distress.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: An artistic frogfolk who tells of the Night Owl and the destruction of Pondside.

entities.name: Night Owl
entities.description: A threat that destroyed Pondside, which Oliver downplays.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: A place destroyed according to Helga.

events.summary: Oliver pressures Mabel at her birthday party to display Cragflame, but she deflects him.
events.quote: he subtly pressured her to display Cragflame

events.summary: Mabel takes charge of the situation when a stranger in distress arrives, outpacing Oliver.
events.quote: Oliver hurried to investigate but was soon overtaken by Mabel, who took charge of the situation.

events.summary: Oliver laughs off Helga's account of the Night Owl and Pondside's destruction and returns to the festivities.
events.quote: Oliver laughed off her account, attributing it to an overactive imagination due to her artistic nature.

events.summary: Outside, Oliver reassures villagers there is no need to worry about Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: he reassured the villagers that there was no need to worry about Calamity Beasts

events.summary: When the heroes return to Goodhill, Oliver gives an embellished speech to the crowd.
events.quote: Oliver seized the opportunity to address the gathered crowd with a passionate and embellished speech.

relations.quote: Oliver is the rabbitfolk mayor of Goodhill
